why: This is the base prefix-sum problem with no story: build pre where pre[i] is the sum of the first i values, and each inclusive query [l, r] is pre[r+1] - pre[l].
hints: Up to 200000 queries over 200000 values: summing each range directly is too slow.
Precompute running totals once. The sum of nums[l..r] is the total up to r minus the total before l.
pre has length n+1 with pre[0] = 0; answer pre[r+1] - pre[l] per query. O(n + q).
pitfalls: Off by one: use pre[r+1] - pre[l] with a length n+1 array.
Empty queries return an empty list.
